name: Release desktop installers

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: Platform to build
        required: false
        default: windows
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - windows
          - macos
      prerelease_tag:
        description: Non-v semver tag for a production-parity pre-release (e.g. 2.1.0-rc.1)
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: desktop-release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  macos-apple-silicon:
    name: macOS Apple Silicon
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      (inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - name: Set app version from release tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "${{ github.ref_name }}"
      - name: Set app version from pre-release tag
        if: inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}"
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Enable pnpm for web profile install
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@11.21.0 --activate
      # The bundled web profile (data/profiles/web) tracks only its manifests in
      # git; the plugin node_modules is rebuilt from the committed lockfile on
      # every runner. git-hosted deps need the runner's git + network, and
      # dsh-llm-opencode resolves into the packages/ submodule (checked out above).
      - name: Install web profile plugins
        working-directory: data/profiles/web
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Validate Apple release secrets
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        env:
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_KEY }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_ISSUER }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          required=(CSC_LINK CSC_KEY_PASSWORD APPLE_API_KEY_CONTENT APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER APPLE_TEAM_ID)
          for name in "${required[@]}"; do
            test -n "${!name}" || { echo "::error::Missing required secret: $name"; exit 1; }
          done
      - name: Prepare Apple notarization key
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_KEY }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_ISSUER }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          key_path="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey_${APPLE_API_KEY_ID}.p8"
          printf '%s' "$APPLE_API_KEY_CONTENT" > "$key_path"
          chmod 600 "$key_path"
          echo "APPLE_API_KEY=$key_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APPLE_API_KEY_ID=$APPLE_API_KEY_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APPLE_API_ISSUER=$APPLE_API_ISSUER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "APPLE_TEAM_ID=$APPLE_TEAM_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Prepare macOS signing keychain
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        id: signing_keychain
        env:
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: node scripts/prepare-macos-signing-keychain.mjs
      - name: Build signed Apple Silicon package
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        env:
          CSC_KEYCHAIN: ${{ steps.signing_keychain.outputs.keychain }}
        run: npm run package:mac:arm64
      - name: Build isolated Apple Silicon development package
        if: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && inputs.prerelease_tag == '' }}
        env:
          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
        run: npm run package:dev:mac:arm64
      - name: Preserve Apple Silicon update metadata
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        run: mv dist/latest-mac.yml dist/latest-mac-arm64.yml

        env:

        run: |

          codesign --keychain "$CSC_KEYCHAIN" --sign "$identity" --timestamp --force "$dmg_path"
          xcrun notarytool submit "$dmg_path" \
            --key "$APPLE_API_KEY" \
            --key-id "$APPLE_API_KEY_ID" \
            --issuer "$APPLE_API_ISSUER" \
            --wait \
            --no-s3-acceleration

            rm -f "$SIGNING_KEYCHAIN_LIST"

        run: |

          codesign --verify --verbose=2 dist/dsh-desktop-mac-arm64.dmg
          spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=4 dist/dsh-desktop-mac-arm64.dmg

            dist/dsh-desktop-mac-arm64.zip
            dist/dsh-desktop-mac-arm64.zip.blockmap
            dist/latest-mac-arm64.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && inputs.prerelease_tag == '' }}
        with:
          name: macos-apple-silicon-dev
          path: |
            dist-dev/dsh-desktop-dev-mac-arm64.dmg
            dist-dev/dsh-desktop-dev-mac-arm64.zip
            dist-dev/dsh-desktop-dev-mac-arm64.zip.blockmap
          if-no-files-found: error

  sign-windows:
    name: Sign Windows package locally with UKey
    needs: windows-x64
    # UKey signing needs a self-hosted macOS ARM64 runner with the SafeNet
    # runtime. Forks without one opt out via the repo variable; absence of
    # WINDOWS_UKEY_SIGNING publishes the unsigned installer instead.
    if: >-
      always() &&
      (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != '') &&
      needs.windows-x64.result == 'success' &&
      vars.WINDOWS_UKEY_SIGNING == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      JSIGN_VERSION: '7.5'
      JSIGN_SHA256: '602a51c3545a6dc4fb99bd2ea7152b26d1345916d0c93ddfbd5936cb735af91c'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - name: Install release tooling
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Prepare unsigned Windows package
        run: |
          work_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}"
          mkdir -p "$work_dir/release"
          echo "WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR=$work_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-x64-unsigned
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release
      - name: Download and verify Jsign
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jsign_jar="$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/jsign-${JSIGN_VERSION}.jar"
          curl --fail-with-body --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
            --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 180 \
            --output "$jsign_jar" \
            "https://github.com/ebourg/jsign/releases/download/${JSIGN_VERSION}/jsign-${JSIGN_VERSION}.jar"
          test -s "$jsign_jar"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$JSIGN_SHA256" "$jsign_jar" | shasum -a 256 --check
          java -jar "$jsign_jar" --version
          echo "JSIGN_JAR=$jsign_jar" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Sign Windows installer with SafeNet UKey
        env:
          WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN }}
        run: |
          test -r /usr/local/lib/libeTPkcs11.dylib
          test -n "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN" || { echo "::error::Missing required secret: DESKTOP_WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN"; exit 1; }
          installer_count="$(find "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.exe' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
          test "$installer_count" = '1'
          installer="$(find "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.exe' -print -quit)"
          pin_file="$(mktemp "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/jsign-pin.XXXXXX")"
          trap 'rm -f "$pin_file"' EXIT
          chmod 600 "$pin_file"
          printf '%s' "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN" > "$pin_file"
          unset WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN
          java -jar "$JSIGN_JAR" \
            --storetype ETOKEN \
            --storepass "file:$pin_file" \
            --alg SHA-256 \
            --tsaurl http://timestamp.digicert.com \
            --tsmode RFC3161 \
            --tsretries 3 \
            --tsretrywait 10 \
            --name 'DSH Desktop' \
            --url https://www.dshdesktop.com \
            --verbose \
            "$installer"
          java -jar "$JSIGN_JAR" extract --format DER "$installer"
          test -s "$installer.sig"
          rm -f "$installer.sig"
      - name: Rebuild Windows update metadata
        env:
          PRERELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          # On a tag push the version is the tag; on a pre-release dispatch
          # GITHUB_REF_NAME is the branch, so take it from the input instead.
          version="${PRERELEASE_TAG:-${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}}"
          version="${version#v}"
          node scripts/finalize-windows-release.mjs \
            "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release" \
            "$version"
          test -f "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release/latest.yml"
          test -f "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR"/release/*.exe.blockmap
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-x64
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release/dsh-desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release/dsh-desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe.blockmap
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release/latest.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Remove local signing files
        if: always()
        run: |
          case "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR" in
            "$RUNNER_TEMP"/dsh-windows-*) rm -rf "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR" ;;
            '') ;;
            *) echo "Refusing to remove unexpected signing path: $WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR"; exit 1 ;;
          esac

      (needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'success' || needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'skipped') &&

              commit_message=f"Archive {tag}",

          # avoids a read-modify-write race and any dependency on directory

          import json, subprocess, tempfile, urllib.request

              ) as response:

                  ["node", "scripts/build-version-index.mjs", str(names_file), str(index_file)],
                  check=True,
              )
              api.upload_file(
                  path_or_fileobj=str(index_file),

        description: Platform to build
        required: false
        default: windows
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - windows
          - macos
      prerelease_tag:
        description: Non-v semver tag for a production-parity pre-release (e.g. 2.1.0-rc.1)
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: desktop-release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  macos-apple-silicon:
    name: macOS Apple Silicon

      (inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'macos')

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

          submodules: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:

          cache: npm
      - name: Set app version from release tag

      - name: Set app version from pre-release tag
        if: inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}"
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Enable pnpm for web profile install
        run: |

      # git; the plugin node_modules is rebuilt from the committed lockfile on
      # every runner. git-hosted deps need the runner's git + network, and
      # dsh-llm-opencode resolves into the packages/ submodule (checked out above).
      - name: Install web profile plugins
        working-directory: data/profiles/web
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Validate Apple release secrets
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''

          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_KEY }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_API_ISSUER }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          required=(CSC_LINK CSC_KEY_PASSWORD APPLE_API_KEY_CONTENT APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER APPLE_TEAM_ID)

            test -n "${!name}" || { echo "::error::Missing required secret: $name"; exit 1; }

      - name: Prepare Apple notarization key

          if-no-files-found: error

  windows-x64:
    name: Windows x64
    if: >-
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') ||
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
        (inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'windows' || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''))
    runs-on: windows-2022
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - name: Set app version from release tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "${{ github.ref_name }}"
      - name: Set app version from pre-release tag
        if: inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        run: npm version --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version "${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}"
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Enable pnpm for web profile install
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@11.21.0 --activate
      # The bundled web profile (data/profiles/web) tracks only its manifests in
      # git; the plugin node_modules is rebuilt from the committed lockfile on
      # every runner. git-hosted deps need the runner's git + network, and
      # dsh-llm-opencode resolves into the packages/ submodule (checked out above).
      - name: Install web profile plugins
        working-directory: data/profiles/web
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run typecheck
      # The profile ships a tracked `.install-complete` marker fingerprinting
      # package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml. A committed marker is stale by
      # definition, so the packaged app would launch into a doomed profile
      # repair on first start. Restamp from the exact bytes electron-builder
      # is about to pack.
      - name: Stamp profile install-complete marker
        run: node scripts/stamp-profile-install-marker.mjs data/profiles/web
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Check recovery UI on native Windows at three display scales
        run: node scripts/check-recovery-ui.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: windows-recovery-ui
          path: |
            artifacts/recovery-ui/scale-*/*.png
            artifacts/recovery-ui/scale-*/results.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Build Windows release package
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        run: npm run package:win
      - name: Build isolated Windows development package
        if: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && inputs.prerelease_tag == '' }}
        run: npm run package:dev:win
      - name: Smoke test packaged Windows Harness
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SMOKE_EXE: ${{ (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != '') && 'dist\win-unpacked\DSH Desktop.exe' || 'dist-dev\win-unpacked\DSH Desktop Dev.exe' }}
          SMOKE_USERDATA: ${{ (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != '') && 'dsh-desktop' || 'dsh-desktop-dev' }}
        run: |
          $userData = Join-Path $env:APPDATA $env:SMOKE_USERDATA
          $logPath = Join-Path $userData 'logs\harness.log'
          # Run outside the checkout: otherwise Node can silently resolve a
          # missing packaged dependency from the repository's node_modules.
          $sourceExecutable = Get-Item $env:SMOKE_EXE
          $isolatedApp = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ('DSH packaged smoke ' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString())
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $isolatedApp | Out-Null
          Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $sourceExecutable.Directory.FullName '*') -Destination $isolatedApp -Recurse
          $executable = Join-Path $isolatedApp $sourceExecutable.Name
          $packagedNode = Join-Path $isolatedApp 'resources\app\node_modules\node\bin\node.exe'
          if (-not (Test-Path $packagedNode)) { throw 'Packaged Windows node.exe is missing.' }
          # Exercise the actual native binding too; the best-effort fallback
          # must not hide a missing or broken packaged koffi dependency.
          & $packagedNode --input-type=module -e "import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; const require = createRequire(pathToFileURL(process.argv[1])); const resolved = require.resolve('koffi'); if (!resolved.startsWith(process.argv[2])) throw new Error('koffi resolved outside packaged app: ' + resolved); const koffi = require('koffi'); const getCurrentProcessId = koffi.load('kernel32.dll').func('GetCurrentProcessId', 'uint32', []); if (getCurrentProcessId() !== process.pid) throw new Error('Native koffi smoke failed'); console.log('Packaged koffi native binding passed');" (Join-Path $isolatedApp 'resources\app\package.json') (Join-Path $isolatedApp 'resources\app\node_modules')
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Packaged koffi native binding failed.' }
          if (Test-Path $userData) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $userData }
          $desktop = Start-Process -FilePath $executable -WorkingDirectory $isolatedApp -PassThru
          try {
            $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(75)
            $ready = $false
            $endpoint = $null
            while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
              if ($desktop.HasExited) {
                throw "DSH Desktop Dev exited before Harness was ready (exit code $($desktop.ExitCode))."
              }
              if (Test-Path $logPath) {
                $log = Get-Content -Raw $logPath
                if (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($log)) {
                  $match = [regex]::Match($log, 'dsh web: (http://127\.0\.0\.1:\d+/\?token=[^\s]+)')
                  if ($match.Success) {
                    try {
                      $authenticatedUrl = $match.Groups[1].Value
                      $response = Invoke-WebRequest `
                        -UseBasicParsing `
                        -Uri $authenticatedUrl `
                        -SessionVariable harnessSession `
                        -TimeoutSec 2
                      if ($response.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $response.StatusCode -lt 500) {
                        $endpoint = ([uri]$authenticatedUrl).GetLeftPart([System.UriPartial]::Authority)
                        $ready = $true
                        break
                      }
                    } catch { }
                  }
                }
              }
              Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
            }
            if (-not $ready) { throw 'Packaged Harness did not become ready within 75 seconds.' }

            function Invoke-HarnessRpc([string]$endpointName, [hashtable]$request) {
              $rpcId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
              $body = @{
                type = 'client-request'
                rpcId = $rpcId
                method = $endpointName
                payload = @{ args = @{ request = $request } }
              } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
              $response = Invoke-RestMethod `
                -Method Post `
                -Uri "$endpoint/api/$endpointName" `
                -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' `
                -Body ([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) `
                -WebSession $harnessSession `
                -TimeoutSec 30
              if ($response.rpcId -ne $rpcId) { throw "Harness RPC id mismatch for $endpointName." }
              if (-not $response.result.ok) {
                throw "Harness RPC $endpointName failed: $($response.result.error.code): $($response.result.error.message)"
              }
              return $response.result.value
            }

            $workspacePath = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP '数据项素-工作区'
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $workspacePath | Out-Null
            $workspace = Invoke-HarnessRpc 'workspace/create' @{ path = $workspacePath }
            $session = Invoke-HarnessRpc 'session/create' @{ workspaceId = $workspace.workspace.workspaceId }
            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($session.sessionId)) {
              throw 'Harness did not return a session id for the selected workspace.'
            }

            Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
            $stableLog = Get-Content -Raw $logPath
            if ($stableLog -match '\[stderr\]') {
              throw 'Harness reported stderr after workspace and session creation.'
            }
            if ($stableLog -match '\[node\] Harness process exited') {
              throw 'Harness process exited after workspace and session creation.'
            }
            if ($desktop.HasExited) {
              throw "DSH Desktop Dev exited after workspace and session creation (exit code $($desktop.ExitCode))."
            }
            Write-Host 'Packaged Windows Harness smoke test passed.'
          } finally {
            if (Test-Path $logPath) {
              Write-Host '--- harness.log ---'
              Get-Content $logPath
            }
            if (-not $desktop.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $desktop.Id -Force }
          }
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != ''
        with:
          name: windows-x64-unsigned
          path: |
            dist/dsh-desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe
            dist/dsh-desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe.blockmap
            dist/latest.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && inputs.prerelease_tag == '' }}
        with:
          name: windows-x64-dev
          path: |
            dist-dev/dsh-desktop-dev-windows-x64-setup.exe
            dist-dev/dsh-desktop-dev-windows-x64-setup.exe.blockmap
            dist-dev/latest.yml
          if-no-files-found: error

  sign-windows:
    name: Sign Windows package locally with UKey
    needs: windows-x64
    # UKey signing needs a self-hosted macOS ARM64 runner with the SafeNet
    # runtime. Forks without one opt out via the repo variable; absence of
    # WINDOWS_UKEY_SIGNING publishes the unsigned installer instead.
    if: >-
      always() &&
      (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') || inputs.prerelease_tag != '') &&
      needs.windows-x64.result == 'success' &&
      vars.WINDOWS_UKEY_SIGNING == 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      JSIGN_VERSION: '7.5'
      JSIGN_SHA256: '602a51c3545a6dc4fb99bd2ea7152b26d1345916d0c93ddfbd5936cb735af91c'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - name: Install release tooling
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Prepare unsigned Windows package
        run: |
          work_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}"
          mkdir -p "$work_dir/release"
          echo "WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR=$work_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-x64-unsigned
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release
      - name: Download and verify Jsign
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jsign_jar="$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/jsign-${JSIGN_VERSION}.jar"
          curl --fail-with-body --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
            --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 180 \
            --output "$jsign_jar" \
            "https://github.com/ebourg/jsign/releases/download/${JSIGN_VERSION}/jsign-${JSIGN_VERSION}.jar"
          test -s "$jsign_jar"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$JSIGN_SHA256" "$jsign_jar" | shasum -a 256 --check
          java -jar "$jsign_jar" --version
          echo "JSIGN_JAR=$jsign_jar" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Sign Windows installer with SafeNet UKey
        env:
          WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN: ${{ secrets.DESKTOP_WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN }}
        run: |
          test -r /usr/local/lib/libeTPkcs11.dylib
          test -n "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN" || { echo "::error::Missing required secret: DESKTOP_WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN"; exit 1; }
          installer_count="$(find "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.exe' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
          test "$installer_count" = '1'
          installer="$(find "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.exe' -print -quit)"
          pin_file="$(mktemp "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/jsign-pin.XXXXXX")"
          trap 'rm -f "$pin_file"' EXIT
          chmod 600 "$pin_file"
          printf '%s' "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN" > "$pin_file"
          unset WINDOWS_SIGNING_PIN
          java -jar "$JSIGN_JAR" \
            --storetype ETOKEN \
            --storepass "file:$pin_file" \
            --alg SHA-256 \
            --tsaurl http://timestamp.digicert.com \
            --tsmode RFC3161 \
            --tsretries 3 \
            --tsretrywait 10 \
            --name 'DSH Desktop' \
            --url https://www.dshdesktop.com \
            --verbose \
            "$installer"
          java -jar "$JSIGN_JAR" extract --format DER "$installer"
          test -s "$installer.sig"
          rm -f "$installer.sig"
      - name: Rebuild Windows update metadata
        env:
          PRERELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          # On a tag push the version is the tag; on a pre-release dispatch
          # GITHUB_REF_NAME is the branch, so take it from the input instead.
          version="${PRERELEASE_TAG:-${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}}"
          version="${version#v}"
          node scripts/finalize-windows-release.mjs \
            "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release" \
            "$version"
          test -f "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR/release/latest.yml"
          test -f "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR"/release/*.exe.blockmap
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-x64
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release/dsh-desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release/dsh-desktop-windows-x64-setup.exe.blockmap
            ${{ runner.temp }}/dsh-windows-${{ github.run_id }}/release/latest.yml
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Remove local signing files
        if: always()
        run: |
          case "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR" in
            "$RUNNER_TEMP"/dsh-windows-*) rm -rf "$WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR" ;;
            '') ;;
            *) echo "Refusing to remove unexpected signing path: $WINDOWS_SIGNING_WORK_DIR"; exit 1 ;;
          esac

  publish:
    name: Publish GitHub Release
    # Windows must succeed; macOS and UKey signing are optional. On a fork
    # without Apple runners those jobs are skipped, which is still a complete
    # Windows-only release (the v0.3.1 shape) — 'skipped' must read as OK.
    if: >-
      always() &&
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') &&
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') &&
      inputs.prerelease_tag == '' &&
      needs.windows-x64.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'success' || needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.macos-intel.result == 'success' || needs.macos-intel.result == 'skipped') &&
      (needs.sign-windows.result == 'success' || needs.sign-windows.result == 'skipped')
    needs:
      - windows-x64
      - macos-apple-silicon
      - macos-intel
      - sign-windows
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        if: needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'success' || needs.macos-intel.result == 'success'
        with:
          pattern: macos-*
          path: release-assets
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        if: needs.sign-windows.result == 'success'
        with:
          name: windows-x64
          path: release-assets
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        if: needs.sign-windows.result != 'success'
        with:
          name: windows-x64-unsigned
          path: release-assets
      - name: Merge macOS update metadata
        if: >-
          needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'success' ||
          needs.macos-intel.result == 'success'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/merge-mac-update-metadata.mjs \
            release-assets/latest-mac-arm64.yml \
            release-assets/latest-mac-x64.yml \
            release-assets/latest-mac.yml
          find release-assets -maxdepth 1 \
            \( -name latest-mac-arm64.yml -o -name latest-mac-x64.yml \) \
            -delete
      - name: Verify release assets before publication
        env:
          MACOS_ARM64_RESULT: ${{ needs.macos-apple-silicon.result }}
          MACOS_X64_RESULT: ${{ needs.macos-intel.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          platforms="windows"
          if [ "$MACOS_ARM64_RESULT" = "success" ] || [ "$MACOS_X64_RESULT" = "success" ]; then
            platforms="all"
          fi
          echo "Verifying release assets for platforms: $platforms"
          node scripts/verify-release-assets.mjs release-assets "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" --platforms "$platforms"
      - name: Build GitHub release note prompt
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .github/release-artifacts
          git fetch --force --tags
          python3 .github/scripts/github_release_notes.py build-prompt \
            --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --output .github/release-artifacts/github-release-prompt.txt
      - name: Generate GitHub release note
        env:
          COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MODELS_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out=.github/release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md
          if [ -n "${COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "Generating GitHub release note via Copilot CLI..."
            npm install -g @github/copilot@latest || true
            prompt="$(cat .github/release-artifacts/github-release-prompt.txt)"
            if copilot -p "$prompt" -s --model gpt-5.6-terra --no-ask-user > "$out" 2>/dev/null && \
               python3 .github/scripts/github_release_notes.py validate --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --input "$out"; then
              echo "✅ AI GitHub release note generated and validated."
            else
              echo "⚠️ Falling back to the deterministic GitHub release note."
              python3 .github/scripts/github_release_notes.py generate-fallback --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --output "$out"
            fi
          else
            echo "MODELS_TOKEN not set; using the deterministic GitHub release note."
            python3 .github/scripts/github_release_notes.py generate-fallback --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --output "$out"
          fi
      - name: Create or update release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          notes=.github/release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md
          if gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets/* --clobber --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
            gh release edit "$RELEASE_TAG" --notes-file "$notes" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          else
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets/* \
              --verify-tag \
              --notes-file "$notes" \
              --title "DSH Desktop $RELEASE_TAG" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          fi
      - name: Mirror release assets to ModelScope
        if: false
        env:
          MODELSCOPE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MODELSCOPE_TOKEN }}
          MODELSCOPE_REPO_ID: alexyaojin/dsh-desktop
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$MODELSCOPE_TOKEN" || { echo "::error::Missing secret MODELSCOPE_TOKEN"; exit 1; }
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/ms-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/ms-env/bin/pip" install -q modelscope
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/ms-env/bin/python3" <<'PY'
          import os, pathlib
          from modelscope.hub.api import HubApi

          api = HubApi()
          token = os.environ["MODELSCOPE_TOKEN"]
          repo_id = os.environ["MODELSCOPE_REPO_ID"]
          tag = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REF_NAME", "unknown")
          src = pathlib.Path("release-assets")

          version = tag[1:] if tag.startswith("v") else tag

          api.upload_folder(
              repo_id=repo_id,
              folder_path=str(src),
              path_in_repo="releases/latest",
              commit_message=f"Release {tag}",
              token=token,
          )
          print(f"✅ Uploaded {src} -> {repo_id}/releases/latest")

          # Immutable per-version archive so the desktop client can roll back.
          api.upload_folder(
              repo_id=repo_id,
              folder_path=str(src),
              path_in_repo=f"releases/archive/{version}",
              commit_message=f"Archive {tag}",
              token=token,
          )
          print(f"✅ Archived {src} -> {repo_id}/releases/archive/{version}")

          # Rebuild the rollback index from the versions we know exist: whatever
          # the current published index lists, plus the one just archived. This
          # avoids a read-modify-write race and any dependency on directory
          # listing.
          import json, subprocess, tempfile, urllib.request

          known = {version}
          try:
              with urllib.request.urlopen(
                  "https://dshdesktop.com/updates/versions.json", timeout=15
              ) as response:
                  current = json.load(response)
              for entry in current.get("versions", []):
                  name = entry.get("version")
                  if isinstance(name, str) and name:
                      known.add(name)
          except Exception as error:  # first release, or index temporarily missing
              print(f"⚠️ Could not read existing version index: {error}")

          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as work:
              names_file = pathlib.Path(work) / "names.json"
              index_file = pathlib.Path(work) / "versions.json"
              names_file.write_text(json.dumps(sorted(known)))
              subprocess.run(
                  ["node", "scripts/build-version-index.mjs", str(names_file), str(index_file)],
                  check=True,
              )
              api.upload_file(
                  path_or_fileobj=str(index_file),
                  path_in_repo="releases/versions.json",
                  repo_id=repo_id,
                  commit_message=f"Version index after {tag}",
                  token=token,
              )
          print("✅ Rebuilt releases/versions.json")
          PY

      - name: Build Feishu release note prompt
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .github/release-artifacts
          git fetch --force --tags
          python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py build-prompt \
            --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --output .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-prompt.txt

      - name: Generate bilingual Feishu release note
        env:
          COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MODELS_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "${COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "Generating release notes via Copilot CLI..."
            npm install -g @github/copilot@latest || true
            prompt="$(cat .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-prompt.txt)"
            if copilot -p "$prompt" -s --model gpt-5.6-terra --no-ask-user > .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md 2>/dev/null && \
               python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py validate --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --input .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md; then
              echo "✅ AI release notes generated and validated."
            else
              echo "⚠️ AI generation fell back to deterministic release note generator."
              python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py generate-fallback \
                --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
                --output .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md
            fi
          else
            echo "Generating release notes from git evidence..."
            python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py generate-fallback \
              --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --output .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md
          fi

      - name: Send Feishu release success notification
        if: success()
        env:
          FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK:-}" ]; then
            echo "⚠️ FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK secret not set; skipping notification."
            exit 0
          fi
          python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py send \
            --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --notes .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md \
            --webhook "$FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK"

  publish-prerelease:
    name: Publish GitHub Pre-release
    if: >-
      always() &&
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      inputs.prerelease_tag != '' &&
      needs.macos-apple-silicon.result == 'success' &&
      needs.macos-intel.result == 'success' &&
      needs.sign-windows.result == 'success'
    needs:
      - macos-apple-silicon
      - macos-intel
      - sign-windows
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: macos-*
          path: release-assets
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-x64
          path: release-assets
      - name: Merge macOS update metadata
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/merge-mac-update-metadata.mjs \
            release-assets/latest-mac-arm64.yml \
            release-assets/latest-mac-x64.yml \
            release-assets/latest-mac.yml
          find release-assets -maxdepth 1 \
            \( -name latest-mac-arm64.yml -o -name latest-mac-x64.yml \) \
            -delete
      - name: Verify release assets before publication
        run: node scripts/verify-release-assets.mjs release-assets "${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}"
      - name: Create or update pre-release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets/* --clobber --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          else
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets/* \
              --prerelease \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --generate-notes \
              --title "DSH Desktop $RELEASE_TAG（预发布）" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          fi
      - name: Mirror pre-release assets to ModelScope
        if: false
        env:
          MODELSCOPE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MODELSCOPE_TOKEN }}
          MODELSCOPE_REPO_ID: alexyaojin/dsh-desktop
          PRERELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$MODELSCOPE_TOKEN" || { echo "::error::Missing secret MODELSCOPE_TOKEN"; exit 1; }
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/ms-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/ms-env/bin/pip" install -q modelscope
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/ms-env/bin/python3" <<'PY'
          import os, pathlib
          from modelscope.hub.api import HubApi

          api = HubApi()
          token = os.environ["MODELSCOPE_TOKEN"]
          repo_id = os.environ["MODELSCOPE_REPO_ID"]
          tag = os.environ["PRERELEASE_TAG"]
          src = pathlib.Path("release-assets")

          for path_in_repo in (f"releases/prerelease/{tag}", "releases/prerelease/latest"):
              api.upload_folder(
                  repo_id=repo_id,
                  folder_path=str(src),
                  path_in_repo=path_in_repo,
                  commit_message=f"Pre-release {tag}",
                  token=token,
              )
              print(f"✅ Uploaded {src} -> {repo_id}/{path_in_repo}")
          PY

      - name: Build Feishu prerelease note prompt
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .github/release-artifacts
          git fetch --force --tags
          python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py build-prompt \
            --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --prerelease \
            --output .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-prompt.txt

      - name: Generate bilingual Feishu prerelease note
        env:
          COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.MODELS_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "${COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "Generating prerelease notes via Copilot CLI..."
            npm install -g @github/copilot@latest || true
            prompt="$(cat .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-prompt.txt)"
            if copilot -p "$prompt" -s --model gpt-5.6-terra --no-ask-user > .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md 2>/dev/null && \
               python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py validate --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --prerelease --input .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md; then
              echo "✅ AI prerelease notes generated and validated."
            else
              echo "⚠️ AI generation fell back to deterministic release note generator."
              python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py generate-fallback \
                --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
                --prerelease \
                --output .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md
            fi
          else
            echo "Generating prerelease notes from git evidence..."
            python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py generate-fallback \
              --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --prerelease \
              --output .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md
          fi

      - name: Send Feishu prerelease success notification
        if: success()
        env:
          FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.prerelease_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK:-}" ]; then
            echo "⚠️ FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK secret not set; skipping notification."
            exit 0
          fi
          python3 .github/scripts/feishu_release_notes.py send \
            --tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --prerelease \
            --notes .github/release-artifacts/feishu-release-notes.md \
            --webhook "$FEISHU_RELEASE_WEBHOOK"
